status: human-curated English catalogue from P0 and current canonical sources

formulas.name: Strong segment density
formulas.variables: r areal radius; r_s Schwarzschild scale; φ golden ratio.
formulas.caution: A finite horizon value does not prove central regularity.

formulas.name: Weak segment density
formulas.variables: r_s Schwarzschild scale; r areal radius.
formulas.caution: Null paths still require full metric or PPN machinery.

formulas.name: C2 blend
formulas.meaning: Quintic Hermite bridge matching value, slope and curvature.
formulas.limits: Matches both branches through second derivative.
formulas.caution: The original cubic zero-slope dashboard interpolation was not canonical.

formulas.name: Diagonal metric ansatz
formulas.limits: Finite coefficients at r_s; divergent central curvature.
formulas.caution: A fundamental global solution is not yet derived.

formulas.name: Central metric limit
formulas.meaning: Since Ξ→1 and D→1/2, A=D² approaches one quarter.
formulas.caution: Finite A does not prevent curvature divergence.

formulas.name: Central Ricci asymptotic
formulas.variables: R Ricci scalar; r areal radius.
formulas.example: Halving r multiplies the leading term by four.

formulas.name: Central Kretschmann asymptotic
formulas.example: Halving r multiplies the leading term by sixteen.
formulas.caution: Complete singularity freedom is not established.

formulas.name: Static redshift proxy
formulas.meaning: Static clock-frequency proxy in the declared metric.
formulas.example: Observed model frequency is scaled by D.
formulas.caution: Real spectra also contain kinematics and astrophysical systematics.

formulas.name: Schwarzschild scale
formulas.variables: G gravity constant; M mass; c light speed.
formulas.example: One solar mass gives approximately 2.953 km.
formulas.caution: Its global interpretation differs between metric models.

formulas.name: PPN light deflection
formulas.variables: b impact parameter; γ PPN parameter.
formulas.caution: Do not replace by an Ξ-only shortcut.

formulas.name: PPN Shapiro delay
formulas.variables: r1,r2 endpoint radii; d closest approach.
formulas.limits: γ=1 gives the GR-compatible factor two.
formulas.caution: Round-trip duplication is separate from the PPN factor.

formulas.name: PPN perihelion advance
formulas.example: Mercury gives about 42.98 arcseconds per century.
formulas.caution: Weak-field agreement does not test the SSZ interior.
